title: [GMCP 203.036.02] Production path: Package and runtime install, update, rollback, and removal
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-036-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A transactional lifecycle installs supported native, container, Node, Python, Java and standalone servers into isolated immutable environments, resolves prerequisites without ambient mutation, runs health and compatibility gates, atomically activates, rolls back on failure, updates under policy and removes all owned state. Dry-run plans, disk quotas, shared dependency reference counts, interrupted operations and offline bundles are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
